'''bacon 2 Endor Operations, Bacon-style''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bacon 2]]
* '''Published:''' 6 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 EOps bacon2 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I've been out of the loop a while but this deck is still pretty good.  It's able to do a lot of damage draining or fighting in space while controlling your opponent's ground drains ad limiting force retrevial.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

you usually start wipe them out, iao/secret plans, and mob. points.  those 3 cards will let you setup fast force activation.  also you start fear is my ally with the defensive shields underneath it.

This deck is made to setup big crains in space while using walkers and the darth's to hold down the endor docking bay so you can use imperial decree and omniuos rumours.

you have undercover spies which are great usually but against lightsaber combat they don't work well so use enter the bureaucrat to slow their biggest force drain.

imperial command is great in this deck.  use it to prevent getting beatdown, or to do a beatdown of your own!  the fighting power is based on multiple, high destiny draws in this deck.

you don't try to flip the objective.  it is just there because it provides a great platform to launch your space attack.

thanks for reading!

brad bacon 2 eier
